VALUE: The supplied glossary excerpt supports reuse of common SDMX concept identifiers, including OBS_STATUS with codelist ID CL_OBS_STATUS, and refers to Reference area as a DSD dimension. It does not confirm all detailed codelist versions or code memberships used in this template.

The supplied registry excerpt confirms that the SDMX Global Registry provides a searchable codelist catalog with codelist details and export functions. It does not provide detailed entries or versions for CL_FREQ, CL_OBS_STATUS, unit codelists, or the local health codelists used here.

The supplied UN M49 excerpt lists recognized countries and areas with numeric and alpha-3 codes. The synthetic report areas Northland, Centralia and South Coast are not confirmed as UN M49 areas in the supplied evidence.
The report states that all records and values are synthetic; template rows are therefore based on synthetic report evidence and should not be treated as production data.

This template resolves the package codelist-reference conflict by using the accepted CODELISTS artifact identifiers as the authoritative validation references for local coded fields: SYNTH_PH_AGENCY codelists with *_LOCAL suffixes and version 1.0-proposed.

The exact SDMX version and code membership for CL_FREQ were not confirmed from supplied external evidence; FREQ=A is retained only as a CANDIDATE annual-frequency value pending validation against the SDMX Global Registry before strict production loading.

Strict loaders should route FREQ=A to unresolved-code handling unless SDMX CL_FREQ code membership and version are confirmed; all local coded fields should validate against the codebook references stated in column descriptions.
Cause labels resemble broad ICD families, but no ICD version is confirmed; CAUSE_OF_DEATH values use local broad-cause codes rather than ICD codes.
Northland, Centralia and South Coast are synthetic/local reporting areas and are not confirmed in the supplied external area-code evidence.

Mappings from FINAL, PROVISIONAL and ESTIMATED to SDMX CL_OBS_STATUS are not confirmed from supplied code-level external evidence, so the template uses the local observation-status codelist declared in the accepted CODELISTS artifact.
Private-sector bed reporting is incomplete in 2024; the reported Private for-profit 2024 hospital bed observation is marked estimated.
